extraction.scope_of_work: Design, implement, and deploy an enterprise-wide data analytics platform. Includes unified data lakehouse architecture consolidating 12 source systems, real-time ingestion pipelines (50M events/day), self-service analytics with governed data catalog, 25 executive dashboards, 40 operational reports, and ML model serving for fraud detection and credit scoring.

requirements.text: Role-based access control with column-level security
Automated data quality checks with alerting
Support for both batch (hourly) and streaming (real-time) pipelines
Disaster recovery with RPO < 1 hour and RTO < 4 hours

analysis.executive_summary: Contoso Financial Services seeks a vendor to build an enterprise data analytics platform consolidating 12 source systems into a unified data lakehouse. The platform must handle 50M events/day in real-time, serve 65+ dashboards and reports, and host ML models for fraud detection and credit scoring. The engagement spans 24 months for implementation ($2M–$3.5M) with a 36-month managed services tail ($400K–$600K/year). SOX, PCI-DSS, and GDPR compliance are mandatory.
risks: Consolidating 12 source systems into a single lakehouse is complex — data quality and schema reconciliation will be the primary bottleneck
50M events/day real-time ingestion combined with sub-second dashboard queries requires careful architecture (likely Lambda/Kappa with materialized views)
Column-level security across 12 source systems with SOX/PCI-DSS/GDPR compliance requires extensive data classification upfront
24-month implementation timeline is aggressive for this scope — similar projects in financial services typically take 18-36 months
